withdrawal_funds_sent_to_manager.meaning: funds withdrawn from the validator are sent to the StakingManager contract

confirm_withdrawals_executed.meaning: confirmWithdrawals is executed to complete the withdrawal process

confirm_withdrawals_completes.meaning: confirmWithdrawals completes successfully after withdrawn funds reach the StakingManager

funds_automatically_staked_on_withdrawal.meaning: the contract automatically stakes funds when they are withdrawn from the validator

funds_not_automatically_staked.meaning: withdrawn native HYPE is received by the StakingManager without being automatically staked

assumptions: Funds withdrawn from the validator are intended to be received by the StakingManager as native HYPE without automatic staking.
The report describes the scenario conditionally: the failure occurs when funds are automatically staked upon withdrawal from the validator.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who initiates the validator withdrawal or confirmWithdrawals; no caller/authorization condition is given.
Report does not specify the concrete mechanism or checkpoint at which automatic staking occurs relative to confirmWithdrawals.

limitations: The automatic-staking trigger, the no-auto-staking condition, and confirmWithdrawals completion are represented as report-grounded Boolean observables because the report gives no numeric or structural definition.
Only the impossible_confirm_withdrawals impact is formalized; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
